note: Signals that tell a skill where it runs. Names only, never values. A row with verified:false comes from experience, not from documentation: it can only push the answer to chatbot mode, never to agent mode. Open: a Codex cloud task has no signal of its own in this table (no documented variable was found), so it looks like a local Codex session; the setup skill therefore also asks the user before every install.

agent.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION
agent.source: Claude Code sets it for subprocesses of its Bash tool (v2.1.172 and later)

agent.name: CODEX_THREAD_ID
agent.source: Codex puts it into the environment of the commands it spawns

remote.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE
remote.source: Claude Code sets it to true in cloud sessions: the tool runs commands, but not on the user's computer
